item.title: Brisbane and Sydney hit hardest by falling house prices as 5.2% shaved from Australian property values
item.description: Cotality data shows median house prices fell in September as interest rates hit borrowing capacity Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Housing prices are falling in almost every suburb in Australia’s biggest cities, with values dropping faster in Brisbane than Sydney as the slowdown intensifies. Prices nationally have fallen 5.2% from their peak in March to where they were a year ago, Cotality data released on Thursday shows. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Australia’s cheapest mayonnaise is also the best tasting, Choice test finds
item.description: Two supermarket home brands claim equal first while the worst-ranked condiment has double the sugar content of almost all the other products Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A condiment worthy of compliments, or one that gets a dressing down? Consumer advocacy group Choice has taste tested 29 store-bought mayonnaises, and found the cheapest product is also the best. Aldi’s Colway Real Mayonnaise placed equal first with a score of 80%. A jar costs $2.79, or 61c per 100g – the lowest price per unit of the product… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: 'Extraordinarly reckless': Prince Harry says children targeted by paparazzi
item.description: Concerns have arisen regarding Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's children's safety as European paparazzi have been spotted lurking near their new school, jeopardizing their privacy. This move back to Britain was intended to protect their family. Harry's longstanding battle against media invasions began after the death of Princess Diana. The couple has previously changed schools due to similar security issues, and the brothers’ relationship continues to face challenges. Publicado también por: The Times of India - World. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Israeli officials say diverted flydubai incident may be attempted 'terror attack'
item.description: The co-pilot of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv is believed to have stabbed the captain in a possible attempted “terror attack” on Wednesday, forcing the plane to divert to Saudi Arabia where it landed safely, three Israeli officials have said. They said the cabin crew entered the cockpit and took control of flydubai flight FZ1073 from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, which diverted to Saudi Arabia as it flew over Jordanian airspace. One of the officials identified the attacker as an Omani... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post, ABC News Australia. Fuente: CNBC - World.
